rules.name: Dependency Confusion Attack
rules.description: Detection rules for software supply chain attacks: dependency confusion, typosquatting, compromised packages
rules.query: SELECT "siem_supply_chain_supply_chain_057", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%dependency%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%confusion%') AND "value" > 0
